profile.headline: Software Developer, Business Systems Analyst, Quality Assurance Analyst
profile.jobTitle: Software Developer / Business Systems Analyst / Quality Assurance Analyst
profile.summary: Results‑driven IT professional with 5+ years of experience supporting critical business systems across application development, application support, quality assurance, and business systems analysis. Skilled at troubleshooting system issues, analyzing requirements, and ensuring smooth adoption of new software releases. Proven ability to collaborate with cross‑functional teams, translate business needs into actionable technical solutions, and maintain high reliability across production environments. Adept at leveraging diverse technologies to improve system performance, reduce support tickets, and deliver consistent, user‑focused outcomes.

positions.title: Software Developer / Business Systems Analyst / Quality Assurance Analyst
Associate Technical Consultant
positions.description:
• Gained knowledge on how to develop code in an efficient way and document artifacts including unit test plans and to ensure that the output is as per the given specifications and SLAs from highly trained senior developers.
• Utilized Java object-oriented programming techniques throughout extensive projects.
• Grasped ideas on how to manage data using SQL through its DDL, DML, DCL and TCL statements. Obtained a solid understanding of various data types and built-in SQL functions
• Implemented basic to intermediate PL/SQL programs in a challenging environment to understand how to implement business logic and perform data operations for enterprise applications using Oracle database
• Worked in a team setting to demonstrate Front-End abilities using HTMl5, CSS3, Bootstrap 4 through an agile project
• Continuously strived in expanding services and capabilities through self-learning and apply skills that would help clients of Infosys thrive though strategic planning and deliver all business requirements for their projects.
• Worked at Toyota Motor North America, Inc. as a Quality Assurance/Test Engineer to test embedded and cloud services of future Toyota and Lexus vehicle brands. Reported new defects via Jira Atlassian and continuously worked on retesting existing defects to ensure improvements were being made within the multimedia features of the new generation Toyota and Lexus vehicles. Supported in creating well-detailed test cases and worked with product owners to meet product needs. Involved in a variety of testing approaches such as exploratory testing, defect testing, and smoke testing on new software releases. Communicated with all team members in an agile environment to ensure testing deadlines were met

positions.title: IT Analyst (Business/Systems/Testing)
positions.description:
• Conducted end-to-end UAT testing and assured software met requirements and expectations
• Tracked, managed, documented defects and analyzed data within the retail logic system (SAS)
• Reported defects, take screen shots, write a step-by-step flow of actions taken with the usage of Microsoft Word and Jira-Atlassian
• Documented detailed test cases while working in an Agile software development cycle
• Collaborated with multiple teams, including business analysts and developers within the organization frequently for requirements clarification
• Created the user manual for the Business Unit on new releases
• Post go-live problem solving with business stakeholders and the development team
• Resolved and researched issues regarding new systems, system implementations, systems changes and system defects
• Analyst that supported the retail logic system (SAS) that payroll did not process or had problems in field with their retail logic system
• Worked on issues that gets passed level 2 help desk via Zendesk
• Worked with business retail logic system supervisor or people in the field
• Worked with both business team and dev team
• Once escalated to this person, looked into data file to see why it was breaking
• Identified problem and was able to replicate>OK this is issue>created Jira ticket for dev team for the issue>communicated issue to the business (we identified issue, it affected multiple users), dev team worked on it, I tested then gave it green light for deployment>dev team took over
• Not just for bug fixes but also new functions/features from business
• Organized and hosted team meetings on Microsoft Teams
• Applied business intelligence tasks by being exposed with large data within Oracle, SQL Server and Microsoft Excel.

positions.title: Arcos Anesthesia Mobile Record App Developer
positions.description:
• Created a mobile application with six other team members to enable anesthesia providers to quickly document patient data electronically instead of by paper  
• The app was developed in React Native as the frameworks for displays and navigations 
• Used Test Driven Development Methods
• Back end data was stored in MongoDb

positions.title: IT Intern/RPA Developer
positions.description:
• Automated gas scheduling for EBB’s using UiPath (RPA – Bot Technology) and integrated data into Endur 
• Provided development, testing, and production support for RPA implementation, which included industry standards and best practices
• Worked across the business units to provide process and design recommendations for Business, Technology, and Operational strategy reporting for commodities (gas scheduling).
• RPA(UIPath) implementations that include process definition (and potential re-engineering) followed by design, build, test and deployment of the RPA (UIPath) solution
• Responsible for analysis, design and implementing back-end Java code that interacts with Oracle database using SQL in an agile environment
• Built stored procedures, functions and views using Oracle

positions.title: IT Trading Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Supporting the implementation project team with the Configuration Document generation process and Testing of OpenLink Endur, EDF’s new Energy Trading and Risk Management System (ETRM System)
• Completing necessary tasks within the UAT (User Acceptance Testing) phase/environment
• Mapping Endur Pricing Indices with Publication Legal Names for confirmation documents
• Reconciling confirmation document information
• Testing of the settlement’s desktop on Endur to support the back-office processes on reports and analyzing data tie-outs.
• Responsible for testing the Invoice Generation Module
• Worked with Business Analysts to set up the Reference Data for the Document Management System (DMS) in Endur

positions.title: Private Math Tutor (Self Employed)
positions.description:
● Offered the student assistance with developing study strategies in mathematics
● Adapted methods of extracting and interpreting math problems to captivate the student and guarantee success in his math class
● Worked with the student to develop a tutoring plan that fits the student’s individual needs
● Assessed the student’s progress throughout each tutoring session on what concepts he was able to understand after I was done teaching him

positions.title: Math and English Tutor; Online and In Person
positions.description:
● Worked one-on-one with students both electronically and in person to improve and further their understanding of Mathematical and English concepts
● Qualified to teach Algebra 1, English, Algebra 2, Elementary Math, Geometry, Proofreading, Vocabulary
● Produced session reports after each tutoring session in order to track the progress of each student and to ensure that their particular academic needs are met
● Worked closely with parents and the organizations main office in order to schedule and contribute tutoring sessions for students

projects.title: Admin Web Portal - HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, Bootstrap, jQuery, MySQL, J2EE
projects.description:
• Built an admin portal with two other members that allows company internal employees to access the portal and perform admin functions on behalf of company clients
• Designing and implementing 5 different portals based of admin roles:  Admin, Finance Admin, Sales Admin, Human Resource Admin, Engineering Admin
• The work involved designing web pages and standardized GUI components, implementing and coding in J2EE, JavaScript, CSS3 used by all the developers in the team for consistency and maintainability

projects.title: Car Simulation - Programming Language: C++
projects.description:
• Developed a program that runs a car by using a fuel gauge class and odometer class
• Each class contains instances of the Car, filling each with fuel, and driving them
